content.html:
Are you looking for a robot vacuum that can easily move around through tight clearance areas in your room? Then you’ve come to the right place.

Here’s a list of the best thinnest robot vacuums you can buy for low-clearance spaces:

Continue reading to learn more about these robot vacuums and more.

What Is The Slimmest Robot Vacuum?

#1. Eufy 11s Slim

Key Features:

  • The robot vacuum comes with 100 minutes of decent battery life.
  • It has a compact design with a height of only 2.9 inches to move easily around tight spaces.
  • The robot vacuum is covered with anti-scratch glass on top for protection against scratches.
  • The robot vacuum uses infrared signals to avoid obstacles and has 2000 Pa suction power.

What I Like:

The first thing I like the most about this robot vacuum is its affordability. It doesn't come at expensive price ranges, unlike other robot vacuums. And the best benefit you get from this robot vacuum is its low-profile and decent design.

With just 2.9 inches in height, this thin robot vacuum can easily move through areas with less clearance. So you don't need to worry too much about raising your furniture.

This robot vacuum is okay to use on hardwood, tile, or other types of uncarpeted flooring. It performs well on this surface, easily picking up both big and little particles of dirt, such as grains and cereal.

What I Didn’t Like:

It doesn’t come with self-emptying features and doesn’t offer optimal performance when it comes to getting rid of hairs from bare floors.

Pros And Cons

Who Is It For:

If you are looking for a budget-friendly and sleek robot vacuum for light cleaning, this robot vacuum is for you.

#2. iLife A9

Key Features:

  • It offers a runtime of around 102 minutes on a single charge.
  • It comes with a phone control, remote control, and scheduling features.
  • The robot vacuum has a low-profile design with a height of only 3 inches.
  • With this robot vacuum, you can set up an 'electro wall,' which allows you to restrict the movement of the robot vacuum to particular areas.

What I Like:

I like this robot vacuum's low-profile design and affordability. Another noteworthy thing about this robot vacuum is its sound level.

Fast and quiet, this robot vacuum gets the job done swiftly and smoothly. It cleans the room quietly, roughly the same volume as a fan.

What I Didn’t Like:

The main downside of this robot vacuum is that it may not give you optimum performance in removing dog hair. It will also struggle on medium pile carpet.

Pros And Cons:

Who Is It For:

If you are looking for a small-sized compact robot vacuum with all the decent features at an affordable price, this robot vacuum is the right pick for you.

>> Check The Current Price Here (on Amazon)

#3. Yeedi Vac Station

Key Features:

  • It has a 3000 Pa suction power to perform decent cleaning.
  • It has a 450 ml dustbin and a 240 ml water tank which you can use for mopping.
  • It uses VSLAM optical-based navigation technology to map the area.
  • With 200 minutes of runtime, this robot vacuum offers long-lasting performance on a single charge.

What I Like:

The first thing I like the most about this robot vacuum is its self-emptying feature. With this feature, you don't have to worry about the frequent emptying dust from the robot vacuum.

This robotic vacuum cleaner also has reasonable quality. The station and robot both have a matte white body with black details. The robot vacuum also has a high-end feel which is an additional plus.

Moreover, the most noteworthy thing about this robot vacuum is that it has a compact design with a height of only about 3.1 inches. Since it’s not too big, it can work well if you have rooms with a lot of furniture and narrow spaces for the robot vacuum to move around.

What I Didn’t Like:

The robot vacuum struggles when it comes to mopping. For example, the robot vacuum does a good job on high-pile carpets but has trouble with low-pile carpets and large, bulky dirt.

It includes a mopping function; however, you may need to use it more than once to remove stubborn stains. Also, another slight drawback is that you can't store multiple maps in the system.

Pros And Cons:

Who Is It For:

The Yeedi Vacuum Station eliminates a lot of the headaches associated with housework. Its self-emptying feature and battery longevity mean you won't have to interrupt your day to go to the trash can as often with this robot vacuum that empties itself.

But the mopping mode isn't the best, and those whose homes have numerous floors may find the inability to save more than one map from being an annoyance.

Yeedi Vac Station is a good small self-emptying bot that can keep your home clean with less effort if you can overcome these difficulties.

What’s The Benefit Of A Slim Robot Vacuum?

The best advantage of buying slim robot vacuums is their low-profile design; they can even clean under tight areas at a low height.

You don’t need to worry much about robot vacuums bumping into furniture or damaging your furniture.

How Much Clearance Does A Robot Vacuum Need?

Generally, there should be around 4-6 inches of clearance under furniture to allow the robot vacuums to move around without any issues.

Usually, the height of most robot vacuums is under 4 inches. So a clearance of more than 4 inches is enough for the robot vacuums.

Best Way To Raise Furniture To Accommodate A Robot Vacuum

One of the best ways to raise furniture to accommodate a robot vacuum is using furniture risers like this one available on Amazon.

How To Use Any Robot Vac By Giving Your Furniture Enough Clearance

Robot vacuums don't need too much clearance. Just a few inches raised with risers, you're good to use almost any robot vacuum.

We also recommend you read our guide on what to do to stop robot vacuum from getting under furniture and getting stuck.
